name: Blocks Bulk Actions
description: Enhance blocks layout with bulk actions functionality like Delete, Enable and Disable multiple blocks instances.
project_description: Blocks Bulk Actions (BBA) enhances Drupal's default Block layout administration page (Structure → Block layout) with a bulk action system built on a custom BlocksBulkActions plugin type. When enabled it alters the core block_admin_display_form to add a per-row checkbox column, a select/deselect-all toggle, an action dropdown and an Apply button, letting an administrator run one operation over many block instances at once instead of editing each block individually. Out of the box it ships three actions — Enable selected blocks, Disable selected blocks and Delete selected blocks — each applied through Drupal's Batch API. Developers can add their own actions by declaring a plugin annotated with @BlocksBulkActions (id + description, optional bids) that implements execute() and access(); the module discovers them via the plugin.manager.blocks_bulk_actions manager. The module has no routes, permissions or configuration of its own — it reuses the core Block layout page and its administer blocks access control.
